correctness.rationale: Real polynomial determinant factorization is checked symbolically from the complete multiplication tensor; N is positive definite. Identity partial_a F + partial_e F=3((a-e)^2+S^2/3) and partial_a F on the remaining locus force the unique real cubic singular line. Vanishing 4x4 cofactors at rank <=3 implies gradient of determinant zero, hence gradient of F zero. Exact rank-3 witnesses and conjugation yield all 0,3,4,5 cases. SymPy checker independently reconstructs identities and checks 405 real integer sample vectors; finite samples are supporting evidence, not the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The authors motivate zero-divisor geometry for this newly defined five-dimensional algebra but provide a restricted slice. The complete global left/right zero-divisor cubic, its only real corank-two singular direction and its one-sided asymmetry determine a standard structural invariant on the whole algebra. These facts are not mere numeric substitutions or a finite sample and distinguish global multiplication from the quadratic local complex slices.
